The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) in shades of brown and tan, surrounded by a pinkish-purple leathery girdle with white speckles. The background rock is textured and covered with small orange encrusting organisms. A watermark 'WWW.NATUREDIVER.COM' is visible at the bottom.
